doc.title: Arturo Sandoval interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2023

chapter: Career, recognition and jazz in America
title: Music education cuts and the missing Minister of Culture
summary: He argues for music programs in schools and notes the US has no Minister of Culture, citing Churchill on supporting the arts in wartime.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Politics, race and the state of the country

blocks.x: Yes. And I back up my word and I strongly believe what I said. Otherwise I don’t say it. And a lot of music, in general, programs out of the schools in general has been cut. You know that. And that’s another problem. Because music, the only thing it does is create better human beings and make the brain to function a little bit more human and more intelligent and more — how can I say — able to be more compassionate and better quality of person in general. That’s the only thing the music does. Music fills your heart and your soul with good emotion and things and then you feel motivated, you feel like wow, this is great you know. And when you have the experience to play an instrument and participate in any kind of formation, it’s a privilege and also it’s a wonderful experience. It’s a wonderful experience. And then we must support music programs in every school, from kindergarten to college, the university or whatever — what they should do. Another thing I’m going to mention to you, I don’t know if you are aware but I’m going to mention something that’s very strange. Most of the governments around the world within the government they have a Minister of Culture. We don’t have it in the U.S. Are you aware of that?

Yes. We don’t have it. We don’t have anybody within the government that represents the art in general and defend and protect and promote the art and I don’t get it. This is a country, we’re supposed to be the role model of the world in every sense, and we have to take care of that. When Winston Churchill was asked during the Second War, why are you spending so much money promoting and sending artists to the troops and all this kind of thing. And he said, “If we don’t protect that and promote that why are we fighting for?” Wow. I’m a big fan of Winston Churchill by the way. I think he was a brain. He was an incredible guy.
